COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cu.user_nm), ''), CAST(w.created_by AS varchar)) AS created_by, TO_CHAR(w.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, CONCAT('검토:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '-'), ' / 승인:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '-')) AS owner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.assignee_count, 0) = 0 THEN '-' WHEN wa.assignee_count = 1 THEN wa.first_assignee_name ELSE wa.first_assignee_name || ' 외 ' || CAST(wa.assignee_count - 1 AS varchar) || '명' END AS assignee_summary, COALESCE(wa.assignee_ids_csv, '') AS assignee_ids_csv, '' AS reference_ids_csv, w.reviewer_id, IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS todo_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'in_progress' WHEN COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'approved' WHEN COALESCE(appr.pre_apply_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'pre_apply' ELSE 'pre_apply' END AS approval_status_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN '진행중' WHEN COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN '완료' WHEN COALESCE(appr.rejected_count, 0) > 0 THEN '반송' ELSE '미완료' END AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at ,'' AS drafter_app_status ,'' AS reviewer_app_status ,'' AS approver_app_status FROM tb_drafting_work_category w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND cu.login_id = w.created_by LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ru.login_id = w.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND au.login_id = w.approver_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignee_count, STRING_AGG(a.employee_no, ',' ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id) AS assignee_ids_csv, (ARRAY_AGG( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_nm), ''), a.employee_no) ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id ))[1] AS first_assignee_name FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a LEFT JOIN tb_user um ON um.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ( CAST(um.user_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no OR CAST(um.login_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no ) WHERE a.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) wa ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pre_apply_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, MAX(COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at)) AS latest_updated_at, MAX(m.electronic_approval_id) AS latest_approval_id FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) appr ON TRUE WHERE w.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ) AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at) DESC, w.drafting_work_category_id DESC

drafter_app_status, '' AS reviewer_app_status, '' AS approver_app_status FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m JOIN tb_drafting_work_category w ON w.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND w.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND la.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_user du ON du.tenant_id = AND ( g.cata_name = #{workType} OR g.cata_code = #{workType} )
